title: User authentication processed before ssh-userauth was requested
quote: The client sends a service request once a secure transport layer connection has been established. / The 'service name' for this protocol is "ssh-userauth". / If the server supports the service (and permits the client to use it), it MUST respond with the following: byte SSH_MSG_SERVICE_ACCEPT
rationale: After the initial KEX and before any SERVICE_ACCEPT, a UA_* input answered with UA_SUCCESS, UA_FAILURE or UA_BANNER means the authentication service runs without having been requested. The RFCs describe this ordering but state no explicit requirement on the server, hence SHOULD; UNIMPLEMENTED or a disconnect is conforming.
